cycles.name: v50 awake-level onset (not completion)
cycles.terminal_state_qualification: caller attestation; analyzer does not interpret firmware proof
limits: Boundaries are measured-current thresholds, not physical target-rail edges.
Pretrigger includes measured startup charge only if activity begins inside its window.
Subthreshold charge before pretrigger is not proven absent; whole-window energy is also reported.
Plateau classification and firmware completion require the external qualification.
Baseline subtraction assumes stationary background; raw energy is the primary result.
No analog calibration, saturation detection, suppression interpolation, or CN8 bypass correction is inferred.
The 80mA level can begin during final uncached frame validation before SAVE return; this plateau boundary is not a complete-cycle endpoint.

scope: v50 awake current-level comparison only. The observed80mA level may begin before uncached final validation and SAVE return;1.239J is not a complete-cycle energy measurement.
current_limit_source: JS110 manufacturer comparison: 10 A pulse, 3 A sustained; 9.5 A software rejection threshold is not an ADC clipping detector.
suppression_limit: This session predates the raw recorder's explicit suppression-setting snapshot. Auto range was used; finite samples do not exclude substitution near switches.

completion_timing_evidence.scope: Module-local duration evidence; no JS-native physical entry synchronization is inferred.
